Verified at the redirect target: workspace rules are one file per rule in `.devin/rules/*.md` (preferred) with `.windsurf/rules/*.md` still read as a legacy fallback; the legacy single-file `.windsurfrules` at the workspace root is also still read; global rules live at ~/.codeium/windsurf/memories/global_rules.md. This profile keeps emitting the .windsurf path because it is the one still documented as read AND still matches the profile id; a rename to devin-rules is the two-line delta ADR-0013 predicted.
